description: PAID ($0.05). Statutory income tax on a TAXABLE-income figure using the country's verified marginal bracket schedule, with full per-bracket workings, effective rate and marginal rate. You pass the amount in local currency. IMPORTANT: this is tax on taxable income, NOT net take-home pay — reliefs/allowances and social-security contributions are the caller's concern and are not applied (see the response scope_note). Pass api_key if you have one (instant card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the response explains how to pay via x402. The evaluation country is free to try (see list_series). Optional receipt (boolean, default false): on a paid success, include an Ed25519 answer receipt at no extra USDC. An answer receipt is not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} is $0.25 and is not an MCP tool) and is not legal advice. Verify with verify_answer_receipt against /certified/public-key.

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

receipt.description: Default false. When true, a paid success includes an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt) at no extra USDC. Unpaid 402 and free refusals do not include one. Not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.25; that SKU is not an MCP tool).

taxable_income.description: Taxable income in the country's local currency, in the schedule's own period basis (annual for most; monthly for Côte d'Ivoire, Uganda, Ethiopia, Costa Rica)

name: compute_income_tax

outputSchema.description: Income tax on taxable income with per-bracket workings

confidence_label.description: Evidence verdict derived from source type, verification age and the stale flag (answers: the weakest series read). Rules at /label-rules

coverage_label.description: How much of the question is covered: ready = complete; partial = held with a disclosed limitation or default; gap = no number served. Rules at /label-rules

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

label_basis.description: Inputs and the rule ids that produced the two labels

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card

provenance.description: Cited official sources behind the answer

receipt.description: Ed25519 answer receipt when receipt=true on a paid success

status.description: Answer status, e.g. computed or an honest no-answer status
